title: SEANIMALMOVE
description: Development of deep learning models for automated classification of avian sounds and submarine acoustic soundscapes.
tasks: Collaboration in the design and planning of field studies for the monitoring of migratory birds and cetaceans.
Management and maintenance of tracking technologies such as ornithological radars, GPS devices, acoustic recorders and hydrophones.
Processing and analysis of acoustic and movement data for the detection and automated tracking of birds and cetaceans.
Application of deep learning algorithms and acoustic analysis for automated species identification.
Study of spatial and temporal patterns in the underwater and aerial soundscape.
Development of algorithms for the extraction of relevant information from combined datasets.
Communication and dissemination of project results through scientific reports, presentations at conferences and specialized publications.

title: BIRDeep
description: Automatically tracking songbird diversity by developing bioinformatics and deep learning tools to understand spatial-temporal changes in bird communities.
tasks: Use and configuration of specialized field recording devices (audiomoths).
Participation in data collection campaigns in Doñana National Park.
Processing and cleaning of large volumes of bioacoustic data.
Implementation of a model for the detection of songs in spectrograms.
Analysis of results and methodological improvement of the ecoacoustic pipeline.
Collaboration with an interdisciplinary ecology and computer science team.

title: AI-Census
description: Developing AI tools for automated classification and census of biodiversity from camera trap images.
tasks: Developed and managed data preprocessing and processing scripts
Investigated state of the art in image classification using Deep Learning
Implemented CNN-based image classification for mammals in camera trap images
Implemented YOLO-based hierarchical-species detection and classification model for animals in camera trap images
Generated and analyzed final research results

title: Audiotate: Audio Segments Validator & Annotator
description: Lightweight Python-based application built with Gradio for efficient annotation and validation of audio segments.

title: Master's Thesis: Bird Audio Classification with Deep Learning
description: Multi-stage bird vocalization identification using YOLOv8-based Bird Song Detector and fine-tuned classifiers like BirdNET for species classification at local scale.

title: Bachelor's Thesis: Camera Trap Image Classification with CNN
description: Design and application of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) classification models (MobileNetV2 and custom architecture) for camera trap images.

title: Genetic Programming & Boids Simulation
description: Combination of genetic programming and boids flock simulation to recreate input images with an artistic twist.
